pages.text: Click a locomotive empty-handed to get in.$(br)$(li)$(k:key.forward): throttle up a notch$(li)$(k:key.back): throttle down, through neutral into reverse$(li)$(k:key.jump): brake, while held$(li)$(k:key.left) / $(k:key.right): hold to take the left or right way at junctions$(li)$(k:key.reikotrains.whistle): whistle or horn$(li)$(k:key.sneak): get out

With nobody at the controls the handbrake holds the train, and the fire only burns while someone's driving.$(br2)A heavy train takes longer to get going and slows uphill; cars roll downhill on their own. At the end of the line a train stops dead. If the track under a car is broken, the car comes off and drops as an item.
The gauges: notch, speed, fuel and water.

The gauges show the next signal and how far it is, the next switch and which way it's set, the next station, the throttle notch (R2, R1, N, 1 to 4), the speed and the speed limit, which way you're steering, the brake, and the fuel (and a steam engine's water).$(br2)A moving train keeps the world round it loaded.
